## RYANAIR ADDS NEW SHANNON-TOULOUSE ROUTE FOR SUMMER 2027


**GIVING CUSTOMERS THE CHANCE TO BOOK EARLY AND AVAIL OF THE LOWEST FARES**


Following the announcement of its new Shannon to Milan Summer 2027 route earlier this month, Ryanair, Ireland’s No.1 airline, has today (Wed, 18 Nov) launched another exciting new Summer 2027 route from Shannon to Toulouse, which will operate twice per week from 25 Mar 2027.


Known as the “Pink City” because of its distinctive terracotta-brick architecture, Toulouse is one of France’s most vibrant and charming destinations. Nestled in the south-west of the country, it combines rich history, beautiful streets, and a lively cultural scene with a warm, relaxed atmosphere. Visitors can explore stunning landmarks such as the Basilica of Saint-Sernin, wander along the scenic banks of the Garonne River, and enjoy the bustling cafés and markets that give the city its unique character.


Ryanair’s new Shannon to Toulouse route is available to book now via the Ryanair app/website.


**Ryanair’s Director of Comms, Jade Kirwan, said:**


*“Following the launch of our new Milan route for Summer 2027 earlier this month, we’re pleased to be back with more good news for our customers in the Mid-West as we launch another exciting new Summer 2027 route from Shannon – this time to Toulouse – a stunning city in the south-west of France.* *Toulouse is renowned for its unique blend of culture, history, gastronomy, and innovation, making it an ideal choice for everything from a weekend city break to a longer summer holiday. Whether you want to explore the city’s beautiful architecture, enjoy its famous food scene, or discover the wider Occitanie region, this new route offers even more choice at Europe’s lowest fares.*


*This exciting new Ryanair route from Shannon to Toulouse will operate twice weekly from 25 March 2027 and is available to book now via the Ryanair app/website* .”


Welcoming the announcement, **Ray O’Driscoll, CEO of The Shannon Airport Group, said:** *“The announcement of a second new Ryanair route for Shannon in recent weeks is a very positive reflection of the strong demand that exists across our extensive catchment area and of the confidence Ryanair continues to place in Shannon Airport.*


*Toulouse is an excellent addition to our route network and will provide greater choice for our passengers while creating new opportunities to attract visitors to the West of Ireland. Following our strongest route programme in 17 years, we are pleased to maintain this momentum as we continue to grow connectivity for the communities and businesses we serve.”*
